api: Apache Kafka - Producer API (KafkaProducer.send of a ProducerRecord)
correction: None material. 'partial' is supported: enable.idempotence makes the broker dedup by producer ID plus sequence number, per partition, within one producer session (https://kafka.apache.org/41/design/design/, https://kafka.apache.org/41/configuration/producer-configs/). A resend by a new producer instance after a crash is not deduplicated, because transactional.id fences zombies but does not dedup application-level resends. There is no broker lookup by header or key; consumers can only seek by offset or timestamp and scan, within topic retention. Suggest stating the per-partition, per-session scope explicitly in the entry.

api: Confluence Cloud REST v2 - Create page (POST /wiki/api/v2/pages)
correction: 'native_key: no' is literally correct (no idempotency key), but the entry leaves out a material fact: Confluence enforces unique page titles within a space. A second create with the same title is rejected ('A page with the title x already exists in this space'), so title already gives server-side duplicate rejection, though as an error and not a replay of the original (https://support.atlassian.com/confluence/kb/unable-to-update-a-page-on-confluence-cloud-due-to-its-title/; Atlassian 'Won't Fix' on same-named pages: https://jira.atlassian.com/browse/CONFCLOUD-2524; still-open request: https://jira.atlassian.com/browse/CONFCLOUD-45279). Consider recording it as a uniqueness constraint or 'partial'. Lookup: CQL docs show title = as the exact-title example and ~ as fuzzy, and label supports = (https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/confluence/advanced-searching-using-cql/). However, the same page says '=' 'cannot be used with text fields', and CQL runs on the search index (freshness undocumented). The v2 GET /pages 'title' filter is described only as 'Filter the results to pages based on their title.' 'exact' is defensible; confidence is medium.

Quotes verified verbatim (https://docs.discord.com/developers/resources/message): nonce up to 25 chars, 'Value will appear in the Message Create event'; enforce_nonce checks uniqueness 'in the past few minutes' for the same author; Get Channel Messages takes only around/before/after/limit; Search Guild Messages returns 202 with retry_after when not indexed and has no nonce filter. Caveat: the Message object lists 'nonce?' (optional), and the docs do not say it is returned on later GETs. If it is not, list scanning cannot match on it and the class would fall to C. A- holds only on the documented Message schema.

api: Checkout.com - Request a payment or payout (POST /payments)
correction: Category 'exact' is right (GET /payments?reference=..., required param, newest first, only payments from June 2022 onward; https://api-reference.checkout.com/tag/Payments/, https://www.checkout.com/docs/payments/manage-payments/get-a-list-of-payments). But 'There is no documented lookup by metadata' is wrong: the Payment Search API (Beta), POST /payments/search, documents both 'reference' and 'metadata' as queryable fields; it searches the previous 90 days by default (override with from/to) and needs the payments:search scope (https://www.checkout.com/docs/payments/manage-payments/search-and-filter-payments). Also note that GET /payments has a 1,000-record limit (limit 1-100, skip). Native-key details verified: 72h expiry in sandbox and production, 409 on concurrent requests, only successful results replayed (https://www.checkout.com/docs/developer-resources/api/idempotency).
